story_text: As a user, I want to filter tasks by completion status so that I can see only open or only done tasks.

positive.title: Filter tasks by status=OPEN
steps: 1. Create multiple tasks with varying statuses (OPEN, COMPLETE).
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · all returned tasks have status = 'OPEN'

positive.title: Filter tasks by status=COMPLETE
steps: 1. Create multiple tasks with varying statuses (OPEN, COMPLETE).
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · all returned tasks have status = 'COMPLETE'

positive.title: Filter tasks by completion status with no matching results
steps: 1. Create multiple tasks with varying statuses (OPEN, COMPLETE).

positive.title: Filter by status — verify no cross-status contamination
steps: 1. Create multiple tasks with varying statuses (OPEN, COMPLETE).
3. Verify that only tasks with status 'OPEN' are returned.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · only tasks with the specified status are returned

negative.title: Filter by invalid status value
steps: 1. Create multiple tasks with varying statuses (OPEN, COMPLETE).
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states status must be a valid value

edge.title: Filter tasks by status combined with priority
steps: 1. Create multiple tasks with varying statuses (OPEN, COMPLETE).
edge.expected_result: 200 OK · all returned tasks have the specified status and priority
